answers.core: It relates to UI workflow established by the core editor, and involves modification to UI elements that I'm not sure could be done with an add-on. Even if so, requiring it to be an add-on - and thus for the user to know of its existence, find it, install it, et cetera - would be a lot of friction that they may not want to deal with versus just having it built-in to the editor already.
answers.workaround: I'm not aware of how this would be done with a few lines of user-side script.
